brewingStyles.philosophy: Meditation through Tea - Multiple short infusions reveal evolving flavor dimensions
brewingStyles.narrative:
Meditation through Tea - Multiple short infusions reveal evolving flavor dimensions

**Approach:** Use a small brewing vessel (gaiwan or small teapot) with high leaf-to-water ratio

**Technique:** Brew multiple brief infusions (often 7-10), allowing leaves to fully rehydrate between steeps

**Parameters:**
- Water Temperature: 72°C (162°F)
- Steep Time: 30 seconds
- Leaf Amount: 5g per 100ml of water
- Infusions: 4

**Brewing Adjustments Applied:**
- Oxidation (Kill-Green): Kill-green stops oxidation early
- Altitude (lowland): Sea level to 600m - standard brewing
- Astringency (low): Low astringency allows cooler, quicker brewing

adjustmentsApplied.description: Low astringency allows cooler, quicker brewing
